name: Sweet Potato

pros.title: beta-carotene is the signature upside
pros.explanation: The orange flesh gives sweet potato a clear carotenoid identity.

pros.title: fuller texture helps real meals
pros.explanation: That practical fullness is one reason it can work beyond the numbers.

pros.title: sweet role is easy to understand
pros.explanation: It can be useful when sweetness is the job and the portion is deliberate.

cons.title: staple role needs portion context
cons.explanation: It works best when the rest of the meal keeps it grounded.

cons.title: large portions push carbs up fast
cons.explanation: It is still a starchy tuber, so the carb load can climb quickly.

cons.title: needs the right supporting foods
cons.explanation: It works better as part of a fuller plate than as the whole answer.
